summary: The note compares the television miniseries "The Chisholms" to the unsuccessful 1977 NBC series "The Oregon Trail". It describes the premise of that series: Rod Taylor plays Evan Thorpe, a widowed father who leaves Illinois in 1842 with his three children to seek a new life in Oregon. The note is very short and gives no further detail about The Chisholms itself.
